plan.title: Two-bid L1 award rejected by approver

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with two bids on Master QCS.
Verify both bidding vendors appear as real vendor columns.
Verify Vendor B's offered quantity is the prepared 10 units.
Verify the L1 vendor's unit rate is 90.
Verify Vendor B's line amount and total calculate as rate multiplied by quantity.
Verify the lower total is ranked first.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 units to the L1 vendor, Vendor B.
Verify one of two vendors is awarded and the proposal total is 10 × 90 = 900.
Create the proposal from the completed allocation.
Verify the proposal identifies the awarded vendor.
Verify the proposal shows the expected total value.
Fill the proposal fields required before submission.
Submit the award proposal for approval.
Verify the proposal submission remains on the proposal workflow.

args.need: sign in as the approver, open the submitted proposal, reject it with a remark, verify no purchase order was created, and return to Master QCS to confirm awarding can be started again

steps.note: The catalog cannot perform the separate approver login, rejection action, or the resulting no-PO and restart checks.
Assert the proposal is shown as rejected after the approver interaction.
